notes: The tested candidate binary was built with a clean source tree before evidence-only files were added.
The four-target cross builds were repeated after evidence-only edits; their compile exits are recorded, but their VCS-stamped binary hashes are not equated with the clean candidate binary.
The first online npm ci was interrupted after packages had been added; a fresh npm ci --offline then exited 0 using the lockfile.
Go race used CGO=1 as required by race instrumentation; the delivered native candidate used CGO=0.
OpenClaw approval probe failure is retained as a failure; it does not invalidate separate allowed/denied/offline public CLI evidence.
